textCaption: In-game, you’re going to have a joystick on the left and a jump button on the right.
You can drag the joystick to move around and press the jump button to, well, jump!
Along the way, <color=orange>Baby Joe</color> might run into some other dinosaurs.
They might even talk to <color=orange>Baby Joe. </color>
You can click on the arrow button in the bottom-right corner to move on, like you’re doing right now!
Along the way, <color=orange>Baby Joe</color> might have some problems to solve.
This is where you come in: help Baby Joe make decisions as it grows! Baby Joe needs YOUR help to live through his life as a baby parasaurolophus.
Your main goals are simple but important: help <color=orange>Baby Joe</color> find food, seek safe shelter, and avoid hungry predators!
For every situation, you will have three choices. Let me explain how they work:
● The Scientific Choice: This is the correct answer! It helps Baby Joe grow and move to the next stage.
● The Tricky Choice: This choice might seem partially correct, but it isn't the best path. You won't lose a life, but you'll have to try again.
● The Dangerous Choice: Watch out! This choice is unsafe, and Baby Joe will lose one of its lives.
Be careful, explorers! If <color=orange>Baby Joe</color> loses all of its lives, the journey is over, and you will have to start from the beginning
So look closely, think like a real scientist, and choose the most scientifically accurate option!

Now, I hope you're ready. 
Let’s start this incredible journey!
